versions.content: If NvM BswMBlockStatusInformation is true and NvM has a multiblock operation ongoing, for each block processed due to the multiblock operation, NvM shall inform the BswM when it starts to process the block, as being pending, by calling the BswM_NvM_CurrentBlockMode with the related Block ID and, as mode, NVM_REQ_PENDING.
